The fines are due to violations related to board composition listing regulations. In their defense, the companies argue that the appointment of directors falls under presidential powers. They are currently seeking waivers for these penalties.

title: Sensex falls 183 points, Nifty closes below 24,250 as market erases all morning gains. What lies ahead?

Interestingly, despite the main indices' downturn, the market breadth showed a favor for advancing stocks.
